project_type: Vite + React 18 + TypeScript SPA, Tailwind CSS v3, Three.js for 3-D scenes
build_system: Vite 5 — `npm run build` (tsc -b && vite build). Dev server: `npm run dev`.
test_framework: None — no test runner configured. Verification is build + visual browser check.
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run build` — zero TS errors. 2. Run `npm run dev`, open browser at 100% zoom, check each route listed in the plan. 3. Resize to 375 px, 768 px, 1280 px and confirm no horizontal overflow.
environment_constraints: Windows/PowerShell workspace. Project root is 'c:\Users\Dell\Downloads\ibo-website (1)\ibo-website'. All commands must be run from that directory.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md found. Follow existing code style: Tailwind classes, inline React styles only where Tailwind cannot express the value, no new dependencies.
key_patterns: Pages wrap content in <div className='page-scale-80'> to shrink font-size to match 80% browser zoom. The global html font-size staircase in index.css simulates 90% zoom. These two mechanisms are THE root cause of needing to zoom out. FaqScene3D uses '.faq-scene-root { font-size: 75% }' for the same reason on the FAQ page. CoinScene in BurnLiquidity has inline transform: scale(0.889) on its wrapper. All fixes: remove scaling, restore html font-size to 100%, adjust heading sizes to stay proportional.
directory_structure: src/components/ — shared UI components (Navbar, Footer, HeroSection, FanDeckCards, FaqScene3D, etc.). src/pages/ — route-level page components (Home, About, BurnLiquidity, Tokenomics, Whitepaper, FAQ, Roadmap, Transactions). src/data/content.ts — static data. src/config/token.ts — token config. src/index.css — global styles including the zoom-simulation rules. tailwind.config.js — Tailwind theme extensions.
